Custom CNC machining
at LZZ

LZZ is an ISO 9001-certified CNC machining company. Our workshop combines milling, turning and multi-axis machining with dimensional inspection.

How we work
Inside our factory
Company documents and certificate details
How our capabilities developed
Founded in 2017

LZZ began making precision CNC machined parts for domestic equipment manufacturers.

More machining options

We added CNC milling and turning equipment, along with multi-axis machines, to take on a wider range of industrial parts.

Production checks

First-article checks became part of the workflow, alongside inspection during production and before shipment.

More inspection equipment

CMM, height gauges and optical projectors allowed us to inspect more complex custom components.

Overseas customers

We expanded our OEM/ODM machining services to customers in Asia, North America and Europe.

Applications and example parts

We manufacture custom parts for a range of industries. Send your drawing, intended use and applicable standards so we can review the requirements for your project.
